subject: humanities
passage: At the foot of staircases leading into many ancient buildings in Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka, lie semicircular slabs of carved stone known in English as moonstones. The finest examples are carved in concentric bands that include an outer ring of flames; a procession of elephants, horses, lions, and bulls; a row of geese; and, at the center, a half-open lotus. Because the bands seem to lead the eye inward, some scholars have ______ carvings symbolize a journey from the cycle of worldly existence toward spiritual release, though no inscription confirms this reading.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: In the main clause "some scholars have proposed that the carvings symbolize a journey …," the clause beginning with "that" is the object of the verb "have proposed": it tells what the scholars proposed. No punctuation belongs between a verb and its object.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A comma can't separate the verb "have proposed" from its object, the clause beginning with "that."
explanation.B: Correct. No punctuation is needed between the verb "have proposed" and the "that" clause that serves as its object.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A colon must follow an independent clause, but "some scholars have proposed" is incomplete without its object.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A semicolon must join two independent clauses, but it would cut the verb "have proposed" off from its object.
